# Martin Kozmelj

> Senior software engineer at Sportradar, based in Slovenia. Builds web apps with React, Next.js and TypeScript (Angular and Nest.js when needed), mentors teams and explores AI-assisted development. Open to part-time freelance work.

- [Projects](https://kozmelj.si/projects): Client websites and side projects, including 6RaceCraft, Tenis klub Trje 2000 and Estetika Verdnik
